svg.title: Lunaris
svg.desc: Lunaris: lunar orbit propagation with a learned residual gravity field (ST-LRPS). The Moon's near side shows the radial gravity that a degree-25 field leaves out at 100 km altitude, degrees 26 to 200 of the GRAIL GL1800F model: warm where gravity is stronger, cool where it is weaker. A spacecraft is on an inclined orbit.

g.text: Lunar orbit propagation with a learned
Moon: radial gravity that SH25 misses at 100 km (GRAIL GL1800F, degrees 26–200)
